# Redwood Ridge team offsite — venue-screening checklist

**Prepared:** 2026-09-14  
**Purpose:** Screen venues before selecting or booking. Treat hard gates as pass/fail; do not rely on venue marketing copy where direct confirmation is required.

## Event details to fill in
- Date / preferred date range: ____________________
- Expected headcount: ____________________
- Location / travel radius: ____________________
- Working hours: ____________________
- Budget owner: ____________________

## Hard gates — venue must pass all
- [ ] **Business-grade internet confirmed directly by property operations.** Get written confirmation from the property ops contact—not just a website, listing, or marketing PDF. Ask about the meeting room’s connection, expected performance/capacity during our hours, Wi-Fi access and any captive portal, and whether a wired connection is available. Save the ops contact’s confirmation.
- [ ] **Room is reserved exclusively for the team** for the full agreed setup, working, and pack-down window. Confirm the room name, date, hours, layout, and booking in writing; check that no competing booking can displace or interrupt us.
- [ ] **Within the $2,000 budget cap.** Confirm the all-in amount, including room fees, taxes, service charges, catering, AV, parking, and any required minimums. Do not add optional services without an approved budget path.
- [ ] **Fits a one-day, working offsite.** The setup supports product-deep working time; no retreat package or team-building programming is required.

## Working-room fit
- [ ] Private, quiet room with a conference/workshop layout for the confirmed headcount.
- [ ] Display and HDMI available; confirm adapters or bring our own.
- [ ] Whiteboards and markers available.
- [ ] Power outlets / extension cords or power strips available for attendees.
- [ ] Confirm whether a wired Ethernet port is available and can be used; record any limits.
- [ ] Ask who is on-site during the session and how quickly they can help with room, AV, or network issues.
- [ ] If anyone may join remotely, confirm a usable video-call setup and backup path; otherwise do not assume remote access is supported.

## Food and day-of logistics
- [ ] Default team meals to **Tava Kitchen**, unless dietary needs make that unsuitable. Confirm availability, delivery/pickup logistics, and itemized cost before booking.
- [ ] Collect dietary requirements and headcount before placing the order; ensure dietary meals are clearly labeled.
- [ ] Confirm delivery window, drop-off point, on-site contact, and any venue restrictions or catering fees.
- [ ] Check arrival access, parking/transit, building entry, restroom access, and any accessibility needs for the team.

## Written confirmation to collect before choosing
- [ ] Property ops contact’s name and direct written internet confirmation.
- [ ] Room/date/time hold and cancellation, deposit, and rescheduling terms.
- [ ] Itemized all-in quote demonstrating the total is under $2,000.
- [ ] Included room equipment and any extra AV/network charges.
- [ ] On-site support contact and day-of contact details.
- [ ] Catering plan and cost, if venue rules affect Tava Kitchen delivery.

## Decision rule
**Reject or hold** any option that misses a hard gate, lacks written confirmation, or pushes the total over $2,000. # Redwood Ridge team offsite — venue-screening checklist

**Prepared:** 2026-09-14  
**Purpose:** Screen venues before selecting or booking. Treat hard gates as pass/fail; do not rely on venue marketing copy where direct confirmation is required.

## Event details to fill in
- Date / preferred date range: ____________________
- Expected headcount: ____________________
- Location / travel radius: ____________________
- Working hours: ____________________
- Budget owner: ____________________

## Hard gates — venue must pass all
- [ ] **Business-grade internet confirmed directly by property operations.** Get written confirmation from the property ops contact—not just a website, listing, or marketing PDF. Ask about the meeting room’s connection, expected performance/capacity during our hours, Wi-Fi access and any captive portal, and whether a wired connection is available. Save the ops contact’s confirmation.
- [ ] **Room is reserved exclusively for the team** for the full agreed setup, working, and pack-down window. Confirm the room name, date, hours, layout, and booking in writing; check that no competing booking can displace or interrupt us.
- [ ] **Within the $2,000 budget cap.** Confirm the all-in amount, including room fees, taxes, service charges, catering, AV, parking, and any required minimums. Do not add optional services without an approved budget path.
- [ ] **Fits a one-day, working offsite.** The setup supports product-deep working time; no retreat package or team-building programming is required.

## Working-room fit
- [ ] Private, quiet room with a conference/workshop layout for the confirmed headcount.
- [ ] Display and HDMI available; confirm adapters or bring our own.
- [ ] Whiteboards and markers available.
- [ ] Power outlets / extension cords or power strips available for attendees.
- [ ] Confirm whether a wired Ethernet port is available and can be used; record any limits.
- [ ] Ask who is on-site during the session and how quickly they can help with room, AV, or network issues.
- [ ] If anyone may join remotely, confirm a usable video-call setup and backup path; otherwise do not assume remote access is supported.

## Food and day-of logistics
- [ ] Default team meals to **Tava Kitchen**, unless dietary needs make that unsuitable. Confirm availability, delivery/pickup logistics, and itemized cost before booking.
- [ ] Collect dietary requirements and headcount before placing the order; ensure dietary meals are clearly labeled.
- [ ] Confirm delivery window, drop-off point, on-site contact, and any venue restrictions or catering fees.
- [ ] Check arrival access, parking/transit, building entry, restroom access, and any accessibility needs for the team.

## Written confirmation to collect before choosing
- [ ] Property ops contact’s name and direct written internet confirmation.
- [ ] Room/date/time hold and cancellation, deposit, and rescheduling terms.
- [ ] Itemized all-in quote demonstrating the total is under $2,000.
- [ ] Included room equipment and any extra AV/network charges.
- [ ] On-site support contact and day-of contact details.
- [ ] Catering plan and cost, if venue rules affect Tava Kitchen delivery.

## Decision rule
**Reject or hold** any option that misses a hard gate, lacks written confirmation, or pushes the total over $2,000. Internet is a non-negotiable: if property operations will not confirm business-grade connectivity in writing, do not book the venue. Compare only venues that pass the hard gates, then choose the best fit for a focused one-day working session.
